standard.summary: 每 N 个候选 block 跳过 1 个。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Skips one out of every N candidate blocks.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每 N 个候选 block 跳过 1 个。0 表示按比例自动推导；大于 0 时优先于上方比例。

advanced_en.principle: Skips 1 of every N candidate blocks. 0 means derive automatically from the ratio; values above 0 take priority over the ratio above.
